featured_reviews.name: Varun Nair
featured_reviews.review_text: So, we needed to create a royal kit for ourselves. And there’s nothing more royal, than a kit with embroidered logos. So we did some basic searches on Google, browsed through the results and ended up on Customade. There were some negative reviews, but despite that we decided to take a chance. I touched base with the man who runs Customade, Mr. Ali. He’s the most professional and creative person I’ve met in this line so far. So the journey began, we finalised the design and logos and showed him the final draft. Accordingly, he went ahead with it and Voila! We got our dream jersey made within a week and half along with the embroidered logos, stitched collars and sleeves. Further, he also remakes jerseys in case of any mishaps from his end. Very professional and hardworking. If you’ve an out-of-the-box design with you, Mr. Ali is your go-to man
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your kind words. We learn and strive to be better everyday so that our customers enjoy the best result

featured_reviews.name: Work
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had used Shivam Graphics previously and the experience was good printing quality was decent and pricing was reasonable. That’s why I decided to visit again recently, but this time the experience was completely disappointing.

Before visiting, I specifically confirmed on call whether the website prices and in-store prices were the same, and I was told yes. But after visiting, the prices quoted were almost double compared to the website. At those rates, I could easily get the same printing done at much better rates from local shops nearby. No doubt their printing quality is good, but the same quality can easily be found at local stores for a better price.

The biggest issue, however, was the design service. Most of my design work was already ready only the visiting card needed to be designed. I had even shared clear references and explained the style I wanted, something modern and relevant to my domain. Instead of understanding the requirement, the designer simply asked me to select from basic template-based card designs from websites. Those were generic, outdated, and not what I asked for.

When I rejected those templates, the designer created something extremely poor. Basic alignment issues, logo not centered, inconsistent icon styles (one outline icon and another filled), poor spacing these are fundamental design basics. It honestly did not feel like professional work. The design service was honestly a complete waste.

The worst part was when I shared the QR code file. The designer asked me, “Is this your logo?” just because the QR code shape was different from a square. After I explained that it was a QR code meant for the back side of the card for scanning, she added it like a tiny logo icon in the bottom corner. At that point, I genuinely lost confidence in the entire process.

A graphic designer not understanding the difference between a QR code and a logo is shocking in today’s market. Combined with poor design sense and misleading pricing, the entire visit turned into a complete waste of time.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback and for being a returning customer.

We are glad to know that your previous experience with us met your expectations. However, we sincerely regret that your recent visit did not deliver the same level of satisfaction.

Regarding pricing, our website and in-store pricing may vary depending on product specifications, quantities, finishing options, and current offers. We understand the confusion this may have caused and will review the communication provided before your visit to ensure greater clarity in the future.

We are particularly concerned to hear about your experience with the design service. Our goal is always to understand each client's requirements and provide designs that align with their brand and industry. The issues you mentioned regarding design quality, layout, alignment, icon consistency, and the handling of your QR code do not reflect the standards we aim to maintain.

Your feedback has been shared with the concerned team for review and improvement. We genuinely value constructive criticism, as it helps us identify gaps and enhance our services.

We appreciate your past trust in Shivam Graphics and regret that we fell short of your expectations this time. We hope to have an opportunity to serve you better in the future.

Regards,
Team Shivam Graphics
